name: Flight Tracker
author: kairos
description: Shows nearby aircraft, or tracks one flight's progress between its airports, using free ADS-B data

barWidget.description: Nearby aircraft, or one tracked flight's progress, from opendata.adsb.fi

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: adsb.fi free tier - kept at 30s minimum.

schema.label: Bar display
schema.description: Show a single nearby aircraft (pick which one via 'Aircraft selection' below), a count of aircraft in range, or track one specific flight anywhere in the world. Track mode is set up in the widget's panel, where you enter the callsign.

schema.label: Aircraft selection
schema.description: Which single aircraft to feature in the bar/tooltip when Bar display is 'nearest'. Applies instantly — no extra API calls.
